title: 185. "The WORST Year of My Entire Life!!!" - Responding to Reddit Mental Health Posts Pt. 2!
description_html: In this week's solo episode, I am once again reacting to mental health posts on Reddit! I also react to some amazing questions that you guys submitted through my website!

summary: sadie responds to mental health questions from reddit and listeners, covering depression symptoms beyond sadness (like anhedonia and irritability), how to study psychology in college and get involved in research, her experience in the troubled teen industry and why she doesn't recommend therapeutic boarding schools, what it means to trust yourself (and how regulating emotions builds that trust), and how to unpack judgmental thoughts by identifying the unmet need underneath. she shares practical advice on each topic, from navigating the dsm's limitations to recognizing when jealousy is really about wanting connection or validation.
